claude.stdout:
urn finalError;
}
```

`executeTry` calls `handleChatCore` with the right `{provider, model, credentials}` for that try. Account selection from `auth.js` stays, but is invoked per-try instead of in a manual while-loop.

**Key invariant preserved**: same retry semantics, same error responses, same logging.

### `open-sse/handlers/chatCore.js` (minimal change)

Add optional `onOutcome` callback. After each `executor.execute()`:
```js
if (options.onOutcome) options.onOutcome({
  provider, model, connectionId,
  success: providerResponse.ok,
  status: providerResponse.status
});
```

No other changes. chatCore stays focused on translation + streaming.

## 5. What Stays Where

| Concern | File |
|---|---|
| Format detection | `open-sse/services/provider.js` |
| Translation | `open-sse/translator/index.js` |
| Executor dispatch | `open-sse/executors/index.js` |

## 6. Migration Path (Pilot → Production)

Pilot is additive. No existing callers break.

| Week | Action |

| 1 | Scaffold files. Implement `policy.buildPlan()` for single-model + fallback combo (no fusion yet). Wire into `chat.js` behind `settings.orchestratorEnabled` flag. |

| 3 | Add fusion plan type. Add `/api/orchestrator/health` endpoint for dashboard. |
